input: جواهر الأسرار فی معارج الأسفار لمن اراد ان یتقرّب بالله المقتدر الغفّار فهنیاً للأبرار الّذین یشربون من هذه الأنهار.
output: The essence of the divine mysteries in the journeys of ascent set forth for those who long to draw nigh unto God, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving—blessed be the righteous that quaff from these crystal streams.
prediction: The Gems of Mysteries concerning the stages of the journey for him who desireth to draw nigh unto God, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving. Blessed, then, are the righteous who drink from these rivers.

output: He is the Exalted, the Most High.
prediction: He is the Exalted, the Most High.

input: یا ایّها السّالک فی سبل العدل و النّاظر الی طلعة الفضل.
output: O thou who treadest the path of justice and beholdest the countenance of mercy.
prediction: O thou who walkest in the paths of justice and gazest upon the Countenance of grace!

input: قد بلغ کتابک و عرفت سؤالک و سمعت لحنات قلبک فی سرادق فؤادک.
output: Thine epistle was received, thy question was noted, and the sweet accents of thy soul were heard from the inmost chambers of thy heart.
prediction: Thy letter hath verily reached Me, and I have known thy supplication and heard the melodies of thy heart within the tabernacle of thine inmost being.

input: اذاً قد رفعت سحاب الارادة لتمطر علیک من امطار الحکمة لتأخذ عنک کلّ ما اخذت من قبل و تقلّبک عن جهات الضّدیّة الی مکمن الأحدیّة و تصلک الی شریعة القدسیّة.
output: Whereupon the clouds of the Divine Will were raised to rain upon thee the outpourings of heavenly wisdom, to divest thee of all that thou hadst acquired aforetime, to draw thee from the realms of contradiction unto the retreats of oneness, and to lead thee to the sacred streams of His Law.
prediction: Thus hath the cloud of the Divine Will been raised, that it may rain down upon thee the showers of wisdom, cleanse thee of all that thou hast formerly acquired, turn thee away from the regions of opposition unto the retreat of oneness, and bring thee unto the shores of holiness.

input: لتشرب عنها و تستریح نفسک فیها و یسکن عطشک و یبرد فؤادک و تکون من الّذینهم کانوا الیوم بنورالله لمهتدین.
output: Perchance thou mayest quaff therefrom, repose therein, quench thy thirst, refresh thy soul, and be numbered with those whom the light of God hath guided aright in this day.
prediction: That thou mayest drink therefrom, and thy soul find repose therein, and thy thirst be quenched, and thy heart refreshed, and that thou mayest be numbered with them who are guided in this day by the light of God.

input: ولو انّی فی تلک الأیّام الّتی احاطتنی کلاب الأرض و سبع البلاد خفیت فی وکر سرّی و اکون ممنوعاً عن اظهار ما اعطانی الله من بدائع علمه و جواهر حکمته و شؤونات قدرته
output: Encompassed as I am at this time by the dogs of the earth and the beasts of every land, concealed as I remain in the hidden habitation of Mine inner Being, forbidden as I may be from divulging that which God hath bestowed upon Me of the wonders of His knowledge, the gems of His wisdom, and the tokens of His power,
prediction: And though, in those days when the dogs of the earth and the beasts of the land encompassed Me, I lay concealed within the retreat of My secret, and was hindered from revealing the wondrous tokens of His knowledge, the gems of His wisdom, and the manifestations of His power, which God had bestowed upon Me.

input: ولکن مع کلّ ذلک ما احبّ ان اخیّب من قام لدی حرم الکبریآء و یرید ان یدخل فی رفرف البقآء و یحبّ ان یطیر فی سمآء هذا البدآء فی فجر القضآء.
output: yet am I loath to frustrate the hopes of one who hath approached the sanctuary of grandeur, sought to enter within the precincts of eternity, and aspired to soar in the immensity of this creation at the dawning of the divine decree.
prediction: Notwithstanding all this, however, I would not disappoint him who hath stood before the Sanctuary of grandeur, and desireth to enter beneath the canopy of eternity, and longeth to soar into the heaven of this Revelation at the dawn of destiny.

input: لذا اذکر لک بعض ما اکرمنی الله عمّا تطیقه النّفوس و تحمله العقول لئلّا یرفع ضوضآء المبغضین و اعلام المنافقین.
output: I shall therefore relate unto thee certain truths from among those which God hath vouchsafed unto Me, this only to the extent that souls can bear and minds endure, lest the malicious raise a clamour or the dissemblers hoist their banners.
prediction: I will, therefore, recount unto thee a measure of that wherewith God hath honored Me, such as souls can bear and minds can comprehend, lest the clamor of the malevolent be raised and the banners of the hypocrites be unfurled.

input: و اسأل الله بأن یؤیّدنی بذلک اذ هو ارحم الرّاحمین و معطی السّائلین.
output: I implore God to graciously aid Me in this, for unto such as beseech Him, He is the All-Bounteous, and of those who show mercy, He is the Most Merciful.
prediction: And I beseech God to strengthen me therein, for He is the Most Merciful of the merciful and the Giver unto them that ask.

input: فاعلم بأنّ لجنابک ینبغی بأن تفکّر فی اوّل الأمر بأنّ امم المختلفة الّذینهم کانوا الیوم فی الأرض لم ما آمنوا برسل الله الّذین ارسلهم الله بقدرته و اقامهم علی امره و جعلهم سراج ازلیّته فی مشکوة احدیّته.
output: Know then that it behoveth thine eminence to ponder from the outset these questions in thy heart: What hath prompted the divers peoples and kindreds of the earth to reject the Apostles whom God hath sent unto them in His might and power, whom He hath raised up to exalt His Cause and ordained to be the Lamps of eternity within the Niche of His oneness.
prediction: Know thou that it behoveth thee, first of all, to ponder why the divers peoples who are upon the earth have failed to believe in the Messengers of God, whom He hath sent forth through His power, established in His Cause, and made the Lamps of His eternity within the niche of His oneness.

input: و بم اعرضوا عنهم و اختلفوا فیهم و خالفوا بهم و نازعوا معهم و حاربوا بهم.
output: For what reason have the people turned aside from them, disputed about them, risen against and contended with them.
prediction: And wherefore did they turn away from them, differ concerning them, oppose them, contend with them, and wage war against them?

input: و بأیّ جهة ما اقرّوا برسالتهم و لا بولایتهم بل کفّروهم و سبّوهم حتّی قتلوهم و اخرجوهم.
output: On what grounds have they refused to acknowledge their apostleship and authority, nay, denied their truth and reviled their persons, even slaying or banishing them.
prediction: And in no wise did they acknowledge Their Mission or Their sovereignty; nay, they denounced Them as infidels and reviled Them, until at last they slew Them and drove Them forth.

input: و انّک یا ایّها الماشی فی بیدآء المعرفة و السّاکن فی سفینة الحکمة.
output: O thou who hast set foot in the wilderness of knowledge and taken abode within the ark of wisdom.
prediction: And verily thou, O wayfarer in the wilderness of knowledge and dweller within the Ark of wisdom.

input: لو لا تعرف سرّ ما ذکرناه لک ما تصل الی مراتب الایمان و لست بموقن فی امر الله و مظاهر امره و مطالع حکمه و مخازن وحیه و معادن علمه.
output: Not until thou hast grasped the mysteries concealed in that which We shall relate unto thee canst thou hope to attain to the stations of faith and certitude in the Cause of God and in those who are the Manifestations of His Cause, the Daysprings of His Command, the Treasuries of His revelation, and the Repositories of His knowledge.
prediction: Unless thou comprehendest the mystery of that which We have revealed unto thee, thou shalt never attain unto the degrees of faith, nor become assured in the Cause of God, in the Manifestations of His Cause, the Daysprings of His wisdom, the Treasuries of His Revelation, and the Mines of His knowledge.
